candidates.description: This vector represents common Hindi sub-word tokens and character fragments.
This vector represents character strings containing variations of the Devanagari retroflex sibilant letter 'ष' combined with various vowel signs and virama.
This feature vector represents conditional and temporal conjunctions, particularly in Hindi and related South Asian languages, relating to words meaning "when," "if," and "then."
This vector represents sub-word fragments, vowel signs, and consonant clusters characteristic of Indic scripts like Hindi.
This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes and inflections, particularly those ending in the nasal sound 'न' (n).
This vector is related to Hindi consonants combined with specific vowel diacritics (matras like 'u' and 'oo').
This vector is related to Hindi consonant clusters and Devanagari script characters.
This vector represents common conjunct consonants and vowel-sign combinations characteristic of the Devanagari script used in Hindi and Sanskrit.
This vector is related to Hindi words and syllables containing Devanagari characters.
This vector represents common Hindi word suffixes and CV/CVC syllable components used in Devanagari text tokenization.
